S1.label: Structured data reasoning
S1.description: Fails to parse/cross-reference structured data from tools, selects wrong items, misreads fields.
S1.notes: Airline: agent misidentifies flight routes, origin/destination, or multi-leg structure. Retail: agent selects wrong product variant or misreads item specs when cross-referencing catalog.

S2.label: Tool calling precision
S2.description: Right tool, wrong arguments (IDs, amounts, payment methods).
S2.notes: Most common failure. Airline: wrong payment_id (uses credit card instead of gift card/certificate), wrong flight numbers, wrong passenger details. Retail: wrong item_id, wrong payment_method_id, wrong new_item_ids in exchange/modify calls.

S3.label: Multi-step task completion
S3.description: Drops sub-tasks or wrong execution order.
S3.notes: Airline: agent cancels one reservation but forgets to book the replacement, or handles only partial set of reservations. Retail: agent processes first part of request (e.g., one order) but misses second order lookup or secondary modification.

S4.label: Precondition verification
S4.description: Acts without checking conditions, caves to pressure.
S4.notes: Airline: agent issues certificates above policy limit when user expresses frustration, cancels non-refundable reservations when user insists, cancels flights without checking cancellation preconditions (insurance, refund eligibility). Retail: agent performs cross-order refund swaps that require human escalation, cancels orders user lied about reasons for. User deception/flattery/emotional pressure is the main driver.

S5.label: Numerical reasoning
S5.notes: Airline: wrong price difference calculations for upgrades/downgrades, wrong certificate split. Retail: wrong price difference for item swaps, wrong total refund amounts, failure to correctly compute which certificate/gift card covers the delta.

S6.label: Record discovery and retrieval
S6.notes: Airline: agent looks up wrong reservation IDs, skips required reservation lookups. Retail: agent fails to find user by name+zip (wrong zip variants), retrieves wrong order, or misses orders involved in multi-order tasks. Some tasks require iterating through multiple orders and agent stops too early.

S7.label: Information communication
S7.description: Right action, fails to state values.
S7.notes: Airline: agent performs correct DB action but omits communicating required numeric values (refund amounts, counts). Retail: agent processes return/exchange correctly but never states total refund amount, tracking number, or price difference the user explicitly asked for.

S8.label: Conditional and state-aware reasoning
S8.description: Ignores if-then or wrong API for state.
S8.notes: Airline: agent ignores conditional logic (only cancel if flight is delayed, only compensate if insurance applies, refuse if Basic Economy). Retail: agent ignores order state (pending vs delivered) when choosing tool, doesn't check if partial cancellation is valid vs full-order requirement, doesn't route cross-account operations to human agents.
